top_signals.title: Pakistan Inflation Exceeds Forecast, Keeping Central Bank Wary
top_signals.summary: Pakistan’s inflation rose faster than expected last month, keeping policymakers on guard as the Middle East conflict threatens to add to cost pressures and complicate the economic outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bessent Ramps Up Pressure on BOJ to Raise Rates Further
top_signals.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stepped up his increasingly public pressure on Japan to raise interest rates as the yen continued to weaken and the nation’s 10-year bond yield touched 3% for the first time since 1996.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
